task.ques: Get the hotel with highest review score and free cancelation in Chennai for 20/12/2026 - 21/12/2026.

claude.final_answer:
FINAL: Pinnacle by Apart Stayz Velachery, Chennai — 10/10 (Exceptional, 2 reviews), with free cancellation for 20–21 December 2026.

Its Superior Queen Room for 2 adults, 1 room offers free cancellation before 6:00 PM on December 20, 2026. The property’s availability table confirms this deadline.

The 10/10 score is tied with T Nagar -S2- 2BHK Aparthotel Shopping central II FLOOR (1 review). Pinnacle has more reviews and appears first in the final “Best reviewed & lowest price” results. All 19 hotels matching the free cancellation and 9+ review filters were inspected.

Evidence: final.png shows Chennai, December 20–21, the applied Hotels, Free cancellation and Wonderful: 9+ filters, the sort, and both 10/10 properties with free cancellation.

Hotel source: https://www.booking.com/hotel/in/pinnacle-by-apart-stayz-velachery.html
